{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient, with the latest test
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
data_filtered = data_dedup[data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL)
mean_baseline = data_filtered['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print result
mean_baseline"}
